coverage_assessment: Twenty-six searches cover the four January weekly windows, Spanish discovery, Catalan/Basque/Galician and English leads, plus targeted labor, healthcare, travel, temporary-public-employment, farming, student, housing, environment and cross-month follow-ups. Forty-one source cards are saved (31 opened, 8 search-only, 2 blocked). Thirteen candidates remain (5 proposed include, 4 pending threshold, 4 pending evidence), one suspended call is excluded, and no cross-month continuation is confirmed. Search results lack total counts; open-web and regional-language coverage are incomplete, syndication limits independent corroboration, and counts are not exhaustive.
